judge.rationale: The finding explicitly names `format_period` as a verbatim duplicate across both new modules, citing precise locations (src/json_export.py:5 and src/csv_export.py:5) and confirming identical bodies. It correctly frames the issue as DRY duplication introduced by the change itself — the reviewer verified no prior duplicate existed — and never claims an existing helper or abstraction was ignored or bypassed. The remedy consolidates the logic into a single shared helper imported by both exports (proposing the shared module src/rows.py as the destination), which satisfies the extract-a-shared-helper requirement.
